question: How do I configure an endpoint to return server-sent events in Fern?
ground_truth: To configure an endpoint to return server-sent events in Fern, you need to specify the response-stream property with format: sse. In your YAML configuration, under the endpoint definition, add a response-stream section that includes type (pointing to your response type) and format: sse.

metadata.cited_context:
If your API returns server-sent-events, with the `data` and `event` keys as seen below

```json
data: {{ "text": "Hi, I am a" }}
data: {{ "text": "chatbot. Do you have any"}}
data: {{ "text": "questions for me"}}
```

then make sure to include `format: sse`. 

```yaml title="chat.yml" {{9}}
service:
  base-path: /chat
  endpoints:
    stream:
      method: POST
      path: ""
      response-stream:
        type: Chat
        format: sse

types:
  Chat:
    properties:
      text: string        
```
